summary.name: Summary
summary.content: Backend engineer with 3 years of experience building reliable transaction systems. Focused on Java, MySQL and Redis, with hands-on ownership from system design to production operations.

items.summary: Order and payment services for an e-commerce platform
highlights: Redesigned payment reconciliation with transactional messaging and retries, reducing discrepancies from 0.3% to 0.002%.
Built multi-level caching with Caffeine and Redis, lowering order-query P99 latency from 420 ms to 130 ms.
Worked with product and QA teams to ship releases, improve monitoring and document incident response.
Implemented an RBAC permission model for 4 business units and more than 200 internal endpoints.

items.name: Distributed Task Scheduler
items.summary: Unified scheduling and observability for 300+ recurring tasks
highlights: Implemented task sharding, failure retries and searchable execution logs.
Built operational dashboards to investigate duplicate triggers and timeouts.
